description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the AttendanceDao class in the OrangeHRM system. It tests various attendance data retrieval methods, including fetching latest records, checking for overlapping punch-in/out records, generating attendance reports, and listing attendance records and summaries. It sets up test fixtures and asserts expected outcomes, focusing on the AttendanceDao's functionality within the Human Resource Management application.

classes.name: AttendanceDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing AttendanceDao functionalities in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures and prepares the AttendanceDao instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetLatestAttendanceRecordByEmployeeId
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the latest attendance record for an employee.

methods.name: testGetAttendanceRecordById
methods.description: Tests fetching attendance record by ID, including non-existent records.

methods.name: testPunchInOverlapRecords
methods.description: Checks for correct handling of punch-in overlapping records and exceptions.

methods.name: testPunchOutOverlapRecords
methods.description: Checks for correct handling of punch-out overlapping records and exceptions.

methods.name: testAttendanceSummeryReport
methods.description: Validates attendance report generation with various filters and total calculations.

methods.name: testAttendanceList
methods.description: Tests retrieving attendance records list and total working time for specific filters.

methods.name: testEmployeeAttendanceSummaryList
methods.description: Verifies employee attendance summaries and counts, including filtering by employee number.
